```csharp
public enum ObserverCorner
```

The screen corner the observer slots are placed against. Chosen with `Corner` on [RadialObserverRig](../radial-observer-rig/). In every layout ([ObserverLayoutPreset](../observer-layout-preset/)) the group of slots is placed touching this corner.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `BottomRight` | `0` | Bottom right. |
| `BottomLeft` | `1` | Bottom left. |
| `TopRight` | `2` | Top right. |
| `TopLeft` | `3` | Top left. |
